verdict.rationale: Netlify's first-party docs describe a REST API for managing sites, deploys, DNS and more programmatically, aimed at automating workflows. That is the core of this story. A published llms.txt and an official CLI further support agent-driven use. Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the usual paths, which leaves the API less machine-discoverable but does not contradict its existence. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence of API reference depth (endpoints, auth, tokens), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Netlify via the API.
